description: She wears an opaque navy wool floor-length gown with a square neckline, fitted bodice, elbow-length sleeves and full skirt. Tan geometric woven borders decorate the neckline, shoulder bands, cuffs, vertical front and hem. A cream linen underdress shows through the modest below-knee walking opening. A grey-brown wool shoulder wrap with blue patterned borders and fringed ends rests across both forearms. A woven belt closes at a round knotwork clasp, with a long tasseled front end; two round shoulder brooches and a dark-stone finger ring are visible. Brown leather shoes show below the hem. No headgear or weapon is visible.
